exam_scheme.note: The Common Admission Test (CAT) is a premier national computer-based management entrance examination conducted on a rotational basis by the Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) for admission to their postgraduate management programmes (PGP/MBA) and other top business schools across India. The test is 120 minutes (2 hours) in duration and comprises 66 questions divided into three non-switchable sections of 40 minutes each. The test includes both Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with negative marking and non-MCQs (Type In The Answer / TITA) without negative marking. Shortlisted candidates based on CAT percentiles are invited for subsequent selection rounds (Writing Ability Test and Personal Interview) by individual IIMs.
